title: Chapter 24 The Weak
content:
Chapter 24 The Weak

After the leader came out, all the soldiers also knelt out one after another. He also held the ground with both hands, kowtowed to the ground with his head, touched the ground, and dozens of sounds appeared in the square.

And they said loudly together: "I am willing to become a pioneer camp, put my heart and soul on the adults, and count the crimes that I have offended before. I also hope that the adults will forgive me and leave us guilty, so that the adults can serve as dogs and horses!"

After he finished speaking, his head slammed to the ground again, and after a few strokes, his scalp was broken, and the blood fell to the ground, turning the original square paved with blue bricks into blood red.

Seeing their attitudes, they were quite sincere, and after accepting his judgment against them, Zhong Yu slowed down, with a cold expression on his face, and said aloud: "Since you wait for your sincerity to change, this lord is not an iron stone. Heart-hearted people. Anyway, I will let you go this time. Next time, remember to keep the heart of being a subordinate and don’t overstep it. Also, remember your choice this time, don’t be slack in the slightest, the chance is only once."

Hearing Zhong Yu's soothing tone and the words he just said, everyone was ecstatic, and a smile appeared on their faces, but there was some sadness in that smile.

Freedom, the original freedom that was rare and incomparable, has been lost again. Dignity, the dignity that was originally high above, was once again trampled on the ground and trampled severely.

Only what is lost is the most precious. People often feel dismissive when they have it and abandon it like a shoe. But when I really lost everything, I felt that everything was so precious, but the opportunity has been lost!

Let those, the Yellow Turban soldiers stand up, step back, and rest for a while. Zhong Yu looked at the people in the center of the venue and the young soldiers.

After glancing for a while, no one dared to look at him, and those who were swept lowered their heads, looked at their feet, and did not dare to look up.

After coughing, Zhong Yu's words continued: "Tomorrow, early in the morning, all the soldiers will gather in the center of the square, the army will gather, and they will set off immediately to destroy the remaining two tribe enemies and wipe out the surrounding tribes."

As soon as Zhong Yu's words fell, the originally peaceful environment in the square suddenly became noisy, and the buzzing sounded in his heart. Obviously, they have suffered heavy losses to the Central Region, lost hundreds of elites, and it is somewhat unacceptable that they are going to go to war immediately.

Especially those strong soldiers, they have not experienced any experience, they are completely recruits, and they may not have seen blood.

After seeing the fate of the Yellow Turbans before, they went out on an expedition with hundreds of people, and they returned with less than a fraction. How can they make them immediately accept the reality of going to the battlefield? Their reaction is also the most intense!

On the contrary, it was the Yellow Turbans who were punished just now, and the reaction was more calm. Even without any unexpected expressions, it seems that they have already expected this.

After all, anyone who has experienced war knows that the opportunity cannot be lost and must be seized tightly. Those two tribes, who have just lost their leaders and a large number of soldiers and horses, are at a time when people are in turmoil.

Don't seize the opportunity to destroy them at this time, wait for them to recover and join the surrounding tribes, it will be another hard battle.

Those around, who were not related to this order, also talked about it. After all, many of their relatives are among those soldiers. If they really want to go to war tomorrow, it is very likely that they will say goodbye forever.

Generals die in a hundred battles, strong men return for ten years, and horse leather is wrapped in bodies. This is the fate of soldiers, or, in other words, the death that no one can escape?

In this chaotic world, only the strongest life can survive. What is everyone fighting desperately for? Just to be able to live humbly, to live on, and to live for that shred of dignity. To this end, even if you give everything, you will not hesitate!

Zhong Yu didn't blame them. They who had never experienced such a thing were a little surprised by it, and even fear was normal.

However, Zhong Yu had to interrupt their discussion, because if they were allowed to discuss, then the panic would inevitably spread more and more, and his orders would not be implemented. There will be more twists and turns.

"Quiet, do you still understand reverence? Is there any respect? Did you forget the punishment just now? Do you also want to become a member of the Vanguard Battalion?" Zhong Yu's cold and ruthless words were It sounded in everyone's ears, causing them to feel cold all over, their voices gradually lowered, and finally disappeared without a trace.

Yes, the Lord's order has been issued, and it is impossible to take it back. In front of so many people, if I say a word, then what will be his majesty?

These people, who don't have enough strength, and take shelter under his territory, how can they resist?

To obey his orders and to execute it is the only hope for survival. Even, go a step further, become the hope of the superior.

The faces of all were filled with grief, even some women and old men with tears in their eyes, their sons, or husbands, among those soldiers? This time parting, I don't know if it is life and death!

Many people are changed by the times, and only a few people can change the times! In this world, the victors live and the losers die. Before the victories in the world, life and death are just inevitable causal factors.

These weak people can't have a tragic fate. If they can die early, it might not be another kind of happiness!

Don't feel the grief of continuing to live, feel the mood of your loved ones dying first. Endure the endless exploitation of the upper class, and become an ignorant spirit as soon as possible, knowing nothing? Nothing can be affected. Many people yearn for this kind of life, so there are so many people who don't care about life and forget to die.

After Zhong Yu said this, he continued: "Okay, I won't say anything extra. I know the pain in your heart. I will finish my work early today and go home to talk about the goodbye! Remember, Tomorrow morning, everyone must come to the square to gather, those who violate the order will be shot and killed, and those who escape will be brought to justice by their relatives and reduced to slaves."

When he said these words, a ruthless expression appeared on Zhong Yu's face, and his eyes were cold and sharp, as if to see who had the courage to run away and become the target of his own killing.

Hearing that there is no need to work so hard today, all the people are not happy. Except for those who had no relatives to be soldiers, there was a hint of excitement on their faces.

However, in awe of Zhong Yu's majesty, although his heart was full of intolerance and sadness, he did not dare to show it here. .

Tonight is destined to be a long night, and it is destined to be a night full of grief and sorrow. Mothers will put on armor for their sons, wives will pack up for their husbands, and sons will tell their fathers how they love each other.

On the second day, the moon fell, the sun rose, and the morning light spread over every trace of the earth, piercing the dark night and bringing dawn to the earth.

The warriors will rush to the military camp, go to the battlefield, meet the challenges that belong to them, and do everything for the right to live.

And their families, will silently start a new day of work, forget all sorrows, and start a new life.

The weak are not qualified to demand fairness. In this world, there are too many things that need to be forgotten.

Zhong Yu - A new era has begun, and there is no choice but to fight.
